read_from: proposal.md#更新项目清单 (the R1-R8 table)
note_zh: `depends_on` 是「另一个项目必须先建成」；`blockers` 是「本包之外的一个条件」，并注明谁能解除它。两者失败方式不同，解除的人也不同，因此分开记。一条依赖只在该行自己的前置条件点名了另一个项目时才写入——这就是为什么只有一条。
note_en: depends_on means another project must be built first; blockers are conditions outside this package, each tagged with who can lift it. They fail differently and are relieved by different people, so they are recorded apart. A dependency is written only where that row's own precondition names another project, which is why there is one.
